plain: If you read figmaLink, consumers or a11yRules testId from @hirobius/design-system/manifest, switch figmaLink to figmaUrl; the other two are HDS-internal and gone.

steps.plain: The bundled manifest no longer carries componentSpecs figmaLink; read figmaUrl, which holds the same URL.
The bundled manifest no longer carries componentSpecs consumers (HDS repo file paths) or a11yRules testId (HDS test ids).
